in_marathi.name: Biman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong as Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Biman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Biman is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is composed of two words - 'Bim' meaning mountain and 'An' meaning strong. This name symbolizes strength and stability, reminding one of the unwavering strength of a mountain. It is a powerful name for a baby boy, evoking images of courage and resilience.
